subject.title: Feature: allow account switching from /models buttons for GPT and Claude

question: Should `/models` grow a first-class cross-channel account/profile selector for provider-backed models, and what shared contract should channels implement?
rationale: The current code has the lower-level auth-profile machinery, but choosing how account choices appear, persist, and interact with existing `/model ...@profile` and auth-order behavior is product and compatibility policy.

options.title: Define shared picker contract
options.body: Add a shared account/profile picker model that all supported channel pickers consume, with compatible profile lists and active-profile display.

options.title: Keep typed commands only
options.body: Decide that `/model ...@profile`, `/model status`, and CLI auth-order commands are the supported account-switching path and close the picker feature.

options.title: Scope to one channel first
options.body: Approve a narrower experiment in one channel while explicitly documenting that other channel pickers remain unchanged until the shared contract is chosen.

recommendation.title: Define shared picker contract
recommendation.body: Add a shared account/profile picker model that all supported channel pickers consume, with compatible profile lists and active-profile display.

likelyOwner.reason: The sampled history shows the broadest ownership across model picker, provider identity, and session override surfaces.
